verdict.rationale: Elastic documents a forward compatibility policy: client applications keep working against a newer server before the client is upgraded. That is a first-party versioning and compatibility commitment for its APIs, but there is no evidence of an explicit API versioning scheme or a deprecation policy. Missing for 10: documented API versioning scheme, documented deprecation policy and timelines, deprecation warnings or headers, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: The forward compatibility policy allows client applications to continue to work with the new server before the client itself is upgraded.
